title: The First Banner’s Iron Witness
text:
Tor Veyrhald opened judgment beneath the First Banner.

Eirholt presented medical records. Varok presented the false pursuit trail. Ashpine growers showed antidote penalties. Oren’s seized ledgers connected all three to Duskvein’s Rank Four claim. The Five Dukes testified as survivors rather than trophies.

Raska represented Dravaryn’s damaged pact. Skeldran demanded restitution for hunters sent into Wuyue under forged evidence.

Tor Veyrhald allowed neither side to treat Duskvein’s defeat as the verdict.

[[speaker:tor_veyrhald]]“A foreign victory does not rewrite our Ledger.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Then let your evidence do it.”

The Iron Witness examined what Wuyue had destroyed and what Duskvein had corrupted. He did not grant Sera authority over Isgard because her force had won.

That refusal made his judgment worth hearing.

title: Sera Does Not Kneel
text:
Sera bowed according to Bannerfall courtesy and did not kneel.

She refused Duskvein territory, a temporary Ledger rank and custody of the defeated clan. She asked for three things: a safe road south, uninterrupted medicine for everyone made dependent on Duskvein antidotes and formal termination of the manufactured Wuyue campaign.

[[speaker:raska]]“You destroyed a ranked Guild and request nothing for Wuyue?”

[[speaker:sera]]“I requested our people alive. We have them.”

[[speaker:tor_veyrhald]]“And the eighty fighters?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Also going home.”

Sera observed local law without pretending it stood above her responsibility. She would accept monitoring. She would not accept submission, disarmament or a claim that defeating Duskvein made its civilians hers.

The Pale Orchid stood inside Isgard’s first-ranked judgment and remained nobody’s subordinate.

title: The Woman Above High Sovereigns
text:
Eira placed Sera above the High Sovereigns witnessed at Bannerfall.

Tor Veyrhald agreed. Tae had held thousands outside one impossible step. Huo had removed a clan’s prepared ground. Sera had moved through several Sovereign battles faster than either side could complete them and defeated Mareth’s reinforced lattice without approaching her limit.

The Banner Ledger had no individual place for her.

Sera declined a ceremonial title before one was invented. No one discussed ascension. Nothing about the victory had changed her realm.

That night, Rhen adjusted the recovery blankets around the Five Dukes.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Stronger than High Sovereigns.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Apparently.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Will this prevent you stealing my blanket?”

[[speaker:sera]]“It establishes my authority to do so.”

Isgard could fail to classify her.

Her husband found the practical consequence immediately.

title: Veyrhald Demands the Hidden Army’s Name
text:
Tor Veyrhald asked who placed eighty specialists inside twelve armies.

Sera accepted responsibility and gave no name.

[[speaker:tor_veyrhald]]“An unnamed foreign army is a threat.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Naming it gives every threatened power one structure to hunt.”

He requested command, numbers, recruitment routes and the location from which forty reinforcements had crossed. Sera provided rules of engagement, protected-person counts and a record of every lethal action. She withheld identity and structure.

[[speaker:sera]]“You know what they did. You do not require their families to judge it.”

Tor Veyrhald could compel further questioning only by turning the promised judgment into detention. Doing so would prove Sera’s secrecy necessary.

He recorded the foreign force as the Eighty Without Banners.

The name belonged to Isgard’s uncertainty, not the organization itself.

title: Eighty Hands Answer With Silence
text:
Veyrhald interrogators found no heroic account.

One operative had moved medicine. Another knew one gate. A third had followed a captain whose real name he could not provide. Every answer was truthful and incomplete by design.

Nobody claimed Huo’s arrival, Sera’s plan or the prison breach as personal achievement. Nobody described another cell merely to appear cooperative.

The eighty were not mindless. They disagreed over routes, triage and the correct moment to surrender evidence. Their discipline preserved those differences without exposing people absent from the room.

An interrogator asked Mei who commanded the hidden army.

[[speaker:rulan]]“The woman who accepted responsibility yesterday.”

[[speaker:captain]]“And beneath her?”

[[speaker:rulan]]“The question you do not need answered.”

Eighty people protected one another through boundaries, not identical lies.

Veyrhald learned nothing it could turn into a map.

title: Eirholt Claims the Wounded
text:
Eira claimed every wounded person under medical neutrality.

Duskvein dependents entered the same treatment lanes as injured hunters, Ashpine witnesses and Wuyue operatives. Antidote access could no longer depend upon testimony. No clan could remove a patient until stable.

Luo and Yun remained after the others could travel. Luo shared the command structure he had mapped through treating captors. Yun gave Eira the seven-venom catalogue without absorbing another sample.

[[speaker:eira]]“You need rest.”

[[speaker:yun]]“I have been told.”

[[speaker:luo]]“Repeatedly.”

[[speaker:eira]]“Both of you.”

The alliance remained narrow. Eirholt did not become Wuyue’s banner. Wuyue did not control Isgard medicine.

Two physician systems recognized a future reason to speak again.

title: The Banner Ledger Rewrites Seventh
text:
Duskvein lost seventh place.

The judgment removed its foreign charter, military roads and independent right to field hunting cohorts. The Duskvein Guild was outlawed. Its prisons, foundries and coercive records entered supervised custody.

Eirholt assumed temporary antidote continuity so dependents did not pay for Mareth’s defeat through withdrawal. Ashpine and Rimeford received the right to renegotiate every obligation under neutral witness.

The Ledger left Rank Seven vacant.

No convenient replacement clan appeared merely because one power had fallen. Winter Reckoning would decide later who possessed the depth, service and political trust to hold it.

Isgard punished the Guild without pretending an empty line became simple.

title: Wuyue Is Not a Clan
text:
Mareth had measured Wuyue through five titled people.

Sera corrected the premise before judgment closed.

[[speaker:sera]]“Wuyue is not a clan whose strength can be carried away in five cages.”

It was five Domains that could defend separately, neutral roads that functioned between them, clinics, armies, independent forces, villages and people capable of acting after leaders vanished. Kael and Liang had held borders. Qin had commanded from absence. Lu had supplied another continent. The Crownless Host had protected the country while its commander was captive.

Duskvein had defeated five extraordinary individuals.

It had mistaken that victory for possession of everything those individuals belonged to.

[[speaker:sera]]“You captured proof that our strongest people can bleed. You never captured Wuyue.”

The distinction reached farther than any ranking.

title: The Road the First Banner Allows
text:
Tor Veyrhald opened one monitored road south.

Veyrhald withheld the Gate Seal from pursuit. Dravaryn accepted the judgment inside Bannerfall. Skeldran reclaimed its surviving hunters after recording restitution claims. Eirholt guaranteed every wounded traveler on the route.

[[speaker:tor_veyrhald]]“This ruling answers Duskvein’s crimes.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Not Isgard’s pride.”

[[speaker:tor_veyrhald]]“No.”

A foreign force had entered Southern Isgard and wiped out a ranked guild. Evidence justified the act inside Bannerfall. It could not erase what other regions would believe that precedent required.

Tor Veyrhald promised a road, not peace.

Sera accepted the honest limit and began the return.

title: Southern Isgard Remembers an Orchid
text:
Southern Isgard gave the expedition different names as it left.

Some called Sera the liberator of antidote Hearths. Others called her a foreign threat who destroyed a ranked Guild. Soldiers called her the Pale Orchid Who Had Been Patient.

Rhen became the impossible healer from the collapsed court. Huo became the returned Empty Throne. The Quiet Hands became the Eighty Without Banners. None of the stories possessed the whole truth.

Behind the monitored column, sealed riders left Bannerfall in directions no southern map displayed. They carried one shared report beyond the known Ledger positions and into unrevealed Isgard regions.

**Duskvein Guild has been wiped out by Wuyue.**

No recipient answered before Sera’s people crossed the first southern ridge.

Signal fires appeared anyway.
